```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source('process v5.1.r')
```

```{r}
d_all <- read.csv('d_all.csv')
d_all$countryUS <- as.numeric(d_all$country == 'US')
d_all$area_mental <- as.numeric(d_all$area == "Mental health")
d_all$fda_not_subject <- as.numeric(d_all$FDA == "not subject to")
d_all$price_modlow <- as.numeric(d_all$price == "Moderately lower than")
d_all$price_siglow <- as.numeric(d_all$price == "Significantly lower than")
d_all$mention_similar <- as.numeric(d_all$mention_human == "mention similar to human")
d_all$model_specialized <- as.numeric(d_all$model_type == "a specialized medical AI model")
d_all$lead_company <- as.numeric(d_all$lead_by == "nationally renowned technology company")
d_all$severity_moderate <- as.numeric(d_all$severe_level == "moderate")
d_all$severity_severe <- as.numeric(d_all$severe_level == "severe")
d_all$female <- as.numeric(d_all$female)
d_all$age_29_39 <- as.numeric(d_all$agecat == "(29,39]")
d_all$age_39_49 <- as.numeric(d_all$agecat == "(39,49]")
d_all$age_49_59 <- as.numeric(d_all$agecat == "(49,59]")
d_all$age_59_69 <- as.numeric(d_all$agecat == "(59,69]")
d_all$age_69_100 <- as.numeric(d_all$agecat == "(69,100]")
d_all$edu_somecollege <- as.numeric(d_all$edu == "Some College/Associate Degree")
d_all$edu_hsgrad <- as.numeric(d_all$edu == "HS Grad")
d_all$edu_postgrad <- as.numeric(d_all$edu == "Postgrad")
d_all$edu_lesshs <- as.numeric(d_all$edu == "Less than HS")

cov <- c(
  "area_mental", "fda_not_subject", "price_modlow", "price_siglow",
  "mention_similar", "model_specialized", "lead_company",
  "severity_moderate", "severity_severe", "female", "age_29_39",
  "age_39_49", "age_49_59", "age_59_69", "age_69_100",
  "edu_somecollege", "edu_hsgrad", "edu_postgrad", "edu_lesshs"
)

vars <- c('likely_use', 'countryUS', 'x_active', 'trustworthy', 'easy', 'improve', cov)
```

```{r}
# Planning
d_planning <- filter(d_all, role %in% c('Monitor health status and send alerts',
                                      'Design health improvement plans'))
d_planning$x_active <- as.numeric(d_planning$role == 'Design health improvement plans')
d_planning <- d_planning[complete.cases(d_planning[, vars]), ]
process(data = d_planning,
                      y = 'likely_use', x = 'x_active',
                      m = c('trustworthy', 'easy', 'improve'),
                      w = 'countryUS', cov = cov,
                      model = 8, boot = 5000, hc = 2, seed = 20260826) %>% summary()
```
